overal.goal: Two in-flight requests with the same Idempotency-Key are not serialized; both may execute. Hold an in-process lock per key (and a pending marker on disk) so the second waits and replays the first result. Acceptance: a test fires two identical POSTs concurrently and only one task/plan is created, the second answer equals the first.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
Look at the idempotency middleware in packages/api and packages/web/src before designing the lock.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

IdempotencyStore.withKey chains concurrent callers of one (principal, op, key) in-process and writes a .pending marker on disk while executing: the second request replays the first record (Idempotency-Replayed: true), a different fingerprint is idempotency_conflict, a fresh marker from another process is 409 conflict, a stale one (60 s) is ignored and pruned; v1.test.ts pins two concurrent creates making one task.

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
